steps.code:
# Let's parse the notes to extract date and habit values
import re

parsed_notes = []
for note in all_notes_data:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not match:
        print(f"Could not find date in title: {note['title']}")
        continue
    date = match.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in note['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or ':' not in line:
            continue
        habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
        habit = habit.strip()
        value = value.strip().lower()
        if value not in ('yes', 'no'):
            print(f"Unexpected value '{value}' for habit '{habit}' in note {note['note_id']}")
        habits[habit] = value
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Print first few to verify
for p in parsed_notes[:3]:
    print(p['date'], p['habits'])

# Check if all notes have same set of habits
habit_sets = [set(p['habits'].keys()) for p in parsed_notes]
first_set = habit_sets[0]
all_same = all(s == first_set for s in habit_sets)
print("All notes have same habit set:", all_same)
if not all_same:
    print("Habit sets differ:")
    for i, s in enumerate(habit_sets):
        if s != first_set:
            print(f"Note {i} has extra/missing: {s ^ first_set}")
